content.text: Oscar Cluff - Men's Basketball - Washington State University AthleticsSkip to main contentAll Rotators Playing Scoreboard Washington State University Athletics 2023-24 Men's Basketball RosterPosition: CenterHeight: 6-11Class: JuniorHometown: Sunshine Coast, AustraliaPrev School: Cochise College (Ariz.)High School: Kawana StateWASHINGTON STATE CAREER Junior (2023-24) - Played in all 35 games, starting 23 of those games... averaged 7.0 points, 4.4 rebounds, 1.2 assists, 0.5 steals, and 0.9 blocks... shot 106-of-197 from the field posting a 53.8 field goal percentage... scored a career high 20 points against Oregon State (Jan. 4). COCHISE STATE CAREER Sophomore (2022-23) – During his sophomore season, Cluff plated 26 games, and finished with a 74.8% field goal percentage on the season. He scored 18.2 points per game and averaged 9.8 rebounds per game, while also dishing out 60 assists and 46 rejections on the season. The Apaches reached the Region 1 Championship, bowing out in a close contest to Arizona Western College. Freshman (2021-22) – Cluff headlined the frontcourt at Cochise College (Ariz.). During his freshman season, Cluff led the Apaches to a 29-4 record last season and the conference title in the Arizona Community College Athletic Conference. The Sunshine Coast, Australia native led the country in field goal percentage with a .750 clip (165-of-220) while averaging 12.5 points and 10.8 rebounds per game. Cochise won their region, advancing to the NJCAA Division I Tournament before falling to national-runner up Salt Lake CC in the Round of 32. © 2026 Washington State University Athletics.
